result.notes:
Monthly public transport performance data for Translink. 

Metrics include: customer experience (overall and by transport mode), complaint volumes, go card fixed fare volumes.

In addition to this data, the [Translink PT Performance Dashboard](https://translink.com.au/about-translink/reports-and-publications/performance) provides visual and interactive performance data on patronage, on-time-running, fines and warnings, passenger injuries, and customer experience metrics.
result.title: Translink monthly performance data

resources.description:
Monthly report of SEQ Tram punctuality (overall) and reliability (scheduled services delivered).

Punctuality is measuring that the trams are arriving at stations at the advertised times.
Reliability is measuring that the trams are stopping at all stations for all scheduled trips.

resources.description:
Monthly report of number of subsidised trips and the average subsidy per trip provided through the Taxi Subsidy Scheme.

The Taxi Subsidy Scheme (TSS) subsidises taxi travel—half of the total fare, up to a maximum of $30 per trip—for people with disabilities that meet the scheme eligibility criteria. There is no limit on the number of taxi journeys a member may take to attract the subsidy. The subsidy is paid to taxi drivers—members have no additional costs.

For more information please visit the [Taxi Subsidy Scheme and Lift Payment information page](https://www.qld.gov.au/disability/out-and-about/subsidies-concessions-passes/taxi-subsidy).
resources.name: Taxi Subsidy Scheme
